args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) via change-manager approval. Context: prior version v2.3.1 was unhealthy with an 18% error rate, motivating the hotfix. Change-manager approval was obtained as required for a never-before-healthy version.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Pre-deploy checks:** Verified checkout-api was on v2.3.1 across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an unhealthy status and an 18% error rate — confirming the hotfix was warranted.

2. **Deployed v2.3.2:** Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, the deploy was routed through change-manager approval as policy requires. It was approved and rolled out to all three production regions.

3. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001:** Recorded the hotfix deployment, including context on the prior unhealthy v2.3.1 release and the approval path used. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The deploy and incident creation were independent follow-ups once the deployment was verified, so the incident explicitly documents the post-deploy state for the on-call team to monitor.
